name: Capture-Photo
summary: Copy-paste React camera component for capturing photos in the browser, with a CameraProvider for camera state.
description: A browser-based React and TypeScript component for real-time camera capture, provided as source to copy into your project rather than as an npm package. A CameraProvider manages camera state; the README lists use cases such as profile photo updates, document scanning, product image capture and telehealth photos. MIT licensed.
contains: use cases: profile photos, document scans, product images, telehealth
